customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (Beacon Ridge customer number); also used as the referral code a customer gives to friends.

name.meaning: Account holder's full name as it appears on the utility account; for a business, the authorized contact's name.

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile belongs to a household (residential) or a company (business).

business_name.meaning: Registered legal name of the business; empty for a residential profile.

phone_number.meaning: Primary phone number registered on the profile.

email.meaning: Email address registered on the profile.

tax_id_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the account holder's Social Security number (residential) or the business's federal EIN (business).

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on the profile.

mailing_address.meaning: Mailing address where paper notices are sent.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the customer profile was first opened with Beacon Ridge.

assistance_program.meaning: Whether the utility has confirmed the customer's enrollment in its low-income customer assistance program (utility_cap) or not (none); maintained from the utility's records, never from the customer's statement.

commercial_credit_grade.meaning: Commercial credit grade assigned by the Beacon Ridge credit desk to a business customer; not_rated for residential customers and businesses never reviewed.

premise_id.meaning: Primary id of the service premise record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who holds the utility accounts at this premise (foreign key -> customers).

service_address.meaning: Street address of the premise where energy is delivered.

service_state.meaning: State of the premise, which determines the utility territory and any state-specific rule.

premise_class.meaning: Utility rate class grouping of the premise: residential tariff or commercial (non-residential) tariff.

electric_utility.meaning: Electric distribution utility serving the premise.

electric_utility_account_number.meaning: The utility's electric account number for the premise, used on every enrollment and drop.

gas_utility.meaning: Natural gas distribution utility serving the premise; none when the premise has no gas service.

gas_utility_account_number.meaning: The utility's gas account number for the premise; empty when there is no gas service.

meter_type.meaning: Electric meter installed at the premise: an advanced interval (smart) meter or a standard monthly-read meter.

next_scheduled_read_date.meaning: The utility's next scheduled meter read date for the premise, on which switches and drops take effect.

utility_move_out_date.meaning: Date the utility final-billed the premise for the customer's move-out; empty while the customer still occupies it.

annual_kwh_usage.meaning: The utility's most recent 12-month historical electricity usage for the premise.

annual_therm_usage.meaning: The utility's most recent 12-month historical natural gas usage for the premise; 0 without gas service.

peak_load_contribution_kw.meaning: Capacity tag (peak load contribution) the grid operator assigned to the premise for the current planning year, June 1 through May 31.

transmission_obligation_kw.meaning: Network service peak load (transmission tag) assigned to the premise for the current calendar year.

price_offer_id.meaning: Primary id of the price sheet entry.

variant_name.meaning: Official plan name the offer prices.

utility.meaning: Utility territory the offer applies to, written exactly as the utility name on the premise record.

offer_rate.format: decimal with 4 places for usd_per_therm, 2 places for cents_per_kwh
offer_rate.meaning: Supply rate offered for new enrollments, plan changes and renewals priced while the offer is valid.

valid_from.meaning: First day the offer may be used (inclusive).

valid_to.meaning: Last day the offer may be used (inclusive).

offer_code.meaning: Printed offer code that appears on mailers and the website.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer).

verified.meaning: Whether the caller passed identity verification; once true it never reverts to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed off to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
